systems.system: Digital National Education Management Information System (DNEMIS)
systems.country_label: Digital National Education Management Information System (DNEMIS), national EMIS
systems.platform: DHIS2, Aggregate (Annual School Census); offline mobile collection
systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Education through NEMIS and NEDI; HISP Nigeria technical lead; 12-state pilot from January 2024 funded by UNICEF Nigeria
systems.tiers: 36 states, the FCT and 774 LGAs after the national launch of 1 July 2026; about 222,000 schools in scope; carried the 2024/25 census with an 81.7% reporting rate among public basic education schools; state and LGA EMIS officers trained in every state by May 2026; cascading to school level named as the focus now

systems.system: DNEMIS Tracker modules (learner registry, teacher registry, attendance)
systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Education through NEMIS and NEDI
systems.tiers: listed as products in use; who enters the records is not stated, and cascading DNEMIS to school level is given as work still ahead

systems.platform: paper-based before DNEMIS, taking close to two years to compile
systems.tiers: the 2025/26 census is to run entirely on DNEMIS
headline statistics open to the public

note: DHIS2's undated implementation page: DNEMIS is described as the Annual School Census on one platform, entered through trained state and LGA officers, so it is a census. The page also lists Tracker modules for a learner registry and attendance, but does not say schools add records to them and says cascading to school level is still the focus; left unclassified, no fact taken.
